author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.25 shipped: Layer ship 3b: device-level dead-camera rule
why: Before 3b a dead Frigate entity with a live Protect twin paged HIGH and was held and released as dead, and multi-camera Protect and Reolink person sensors resolved to no camera, so S1/S2 never watched them. Operator rule: if even one NVR has the camera it is not dead. Tier 3 with reviews A, B, C, D, D2, G and an operator go.
implications: Shipped DEAD-CAMERA-DEVICE-RULE-1 at v5.108.25; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.25.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a one-NVR outage visibly delays a census reset, or NVR witness W2 planning starts (DEAD-CAMERA-TWIN-COVERAGE-1).

refs.release_notes: A camera is a registry device; the camera-down page fires only when every paired NVR device has lost it (CameraTwinHealth owner on the CM entry). Device-level input holds, house tracker for unwatched cameras, SENT/ALREADY_SENT/NOT_SENT send result with latch-after-send, bounded room DEFER, camera_twin_health diagnostics counters.
